SARA VS. SARA: A Masterclass in Ideological Whiplash

Let’s give a warm, standing ovation to the undisputed champion of debating oneself: Vice President Sara Duterte. In a stunning display of political evolution or perhaps just a severe case of timeline amnesia…the Vice President has officially entered the ring against her toughest opponent yet: her own past statements.

Let us examine the tale of the tape, brought to you exactly nine years apart.

Corner 1: The 2017 Skeptic

In the top panel, representing February 24, 2017, we have a mayor who simply couldn't wrap her head around the national hype. "I find it hard to understand why this bloodless revolution has become the standard definition of freedom for our country," she declared. Overthrowing a two-decade dictatorship without sparking a bloody civil war? Yawn. Overrated. Why on earth would anyone use the peaceful reclaiming of democracy as the yardstick for liberty?

Corner 2: The 2026 EDSA Guardian

In the bottom panel, stepping up to the microphones on February 24, 2026, we have a Vice President deeply, profoundly concerned about the nation's collective memory loss. "Nakalimutan na ata ng mga tao kung ano 'yung essence ng 1986 EDSA Revolution," she laments.
Gasp. The tragedy!

Suddenly, the very event she previously dismissed as a baffling "standard of freedom" has an "essence" so vital, so sacred, that she must step up to remind the forgetful masses of its importance.

The Highlights Reel

Here is a quick breakdown of this magnificent philosophical gymnastics routine:

🎭 2017 Logic: "Why is EDSA such a big deal?"

🎭 2026 Logic: "Why aren't you people treating EDSA like a bigger deal?!"

🥇 Gold Medal Rating: 10/10 for flawless execution of a 180-degree political pivot without stretching.

The Final Takeaway

It is truly inspiring to witness such a profound metamorphosis. It takes a remarkable amount of flexibility to pivot from questioning the foundational relevance of a historical event to scolding the general public for forgetting its core meaning. Who will win this epic clash of ideologies? We may never know, but we eagerly await February 24, 2035, where she might just claim she was the one who personally invented the color yellow.

📸 CTTO
